title: deadlineType outside the fixed/rolling enum
description: A deadline whose deadlineType — renamed from 'type' — is 'recurring', which is deliberately not in the enum: fixed and rolling are the only deadline kinds, and a recurring program is expressed by grant.recurring plus a rolling or fixed deadline. Also stands in for the other enums inside $defs (ingestedVia, difficulty, stages, contactMethod, accelerator.stage).
